purpose: Measure future selection loss of existing frozen and refreshed AIPW gates when response conditions continue or change between checking and use.

motivation.finding: Both gate point estimates were negative; later candidate-minus-incumbent DR and IPS estimates were positive with exploratory user and time intervals above zero.
motivation.boundary: An exploratory observation among multiple daily comparisons, not proof of temporal causation or a true false rejection.

literature_positioning.claim: Controlled empirical replication/extension of the existing gate pipeline; no established new estimator, forecasting method, safety theorem or publication-level novelty.

targeted_evidence.source: Thomas et al. (2017), Predictive Off-Policy Policy Evaluation for Nonstationary Decision Problems, with Applications to Digital Marketing
targeted_evidence.inspection: Primary proceedings metadata and abstract; full-text retrieval was inconsistent.
targeted_evidence.overlap: Counterfactual evaluation combined with time-series prediction of future policy value already exists.

targeted_evidence.source: Chandak et al. (2020), Optimizing for the Future in Non-Stationary MDPs
targeted_evidence.inspection: Primary abstract and targeted full-text introduction, problem formulation and limitations.
targeted_evidence.overlap: Prognosticator optimizes a forecast of future policy performance; its stated scope uses smooth exogenous changes.

targeted_evidence.source: Chandak et al. (2020), Towards Safe Policy Improvement for Non-Stationary MDPs
targeted_evidence.inspection: Primary abstract; targeted full-text Assumption 1, Section 4 and selected empirical passages.
targeted_evidence.overlap: SPIN separates candidate search from testing and accepts using forecasted future performance bounds. Smoothness assumptions exclude abrupt breaks.
targeted_evidence.boundary: We do not implement or claim to outperform SPIN. Abrupt-change stress testing here does not refute its stated theorem or assumptions.

literature_positioning.proposed_empirical_distinction: Hold current data, candidate/incumbent policies and gate decisions fixed within each seed/current condition, then vary only future response trajectories and delay; separately account for current estimation error, response transfer and finite-panel composition.
literature_positioning.novelty_scope: Exact absence of this evaluation from all prior work is not established. Not a restarted systematic review.

questions: Does candidate refresh reduce future gate-selection loss in the fixed primary gradual-continuation setting?
How do the same recorded decisions behave under unchanged, abrupt or reversing future responses and delays?
How much current-to-future gain-estimation discrepancy is attributable to current estimation, response transfer or finite-panel composition in this controlled generator?

scope.unit: One candidate review per seed/current-response condition; no subsequent controller changes or retraining.
not_tested: A new causal estimator or forecasting algorithm
Operational effects of alternative training windows or review calendars
scope.synthetic_truth: Offline scoring and decomposition only; never provided to fitting, gate scoring or acceptance.

sample_allocation.dependence: All current conditions, future profiles, delays and gate variants remain inside one master-seed resampling block. 4500 cells are not 4500 independent replications.
sample_allocation.allocation_rationale: Fixed pragmatic Monte Carlo allocation, not a formal power calculation. Do not enlarge after inspecting significance.
sample_allocation.freshness_check: Before pilot/validation, scoped scan of saved project CSV seed columns and CSV members of archives for allocated master seeds; reject recorded collisions and preserve report. This cannot exclude undocumented external runs.

generator.logging: Independent Bernoulli treatment with known propensity 0.5
generator.magnitude_rationale: Future younger-group step magnitude equals the pre-existing cost scale, 10; opposing offsets preserve the population-average effect in expectation. Fixed before any new outcomes, not tuned to reproduce April 30.
generator.random_number_pairing: Within each master seed, share current X,T,epsilon across current-response conditions; apply each declared effect surface to obtain Y. Share one independent deployment X panel across all future profiles and delays.
generator.independent_roles: Use NumPy SeedSequence([master_seed,role_code]); role 0 initial observed data, role 1 current observed base data, role 2 deployment feature panel. Split and model fitting use separately declared child-seed codes.
generator.candidate_model_child_seed_code_rule: 100 + 10*current_condition_index + treatment_arm, with declared condition order and treatment_arm 0/1; generate one uint32 using SeedSequence for sklearn random_state.

models_and_gate.family: T-learner with separate random-forest outcome regressors

random_forest.random_state: Declared SeedSequence child seed for each fitted arm

models_and_gate.initial_fit: Unstratified 80/20 split, random_state=42; fit on 800 initial observations.
models_and_gate.candidate_fit: 70/30 current-data split, stratified jointly by subgroup and logged treatment; fit on approximately 700 records and gate on separate approximately 300 records.
models_and_gate.clarification: Different current-response conditions have separately fitted candidates; the same candidate/incumbent pair is retained across the future conditions used to test that pair.
models_and_gate.policy: Treat iff estimated effect > cost 10; equality selects no treatment.
models_and_gate.frozen_gate: AIPW pseudo-outcomes use initial outcome regressors.
models_and_gate.refreshed_gate: AIPW pseudo-outcomes use current candidate regressors, fitted without gate outcomes.
models_and_gate.acceptance: mean(g) - 1.96*sample_sd(g)/sqrt(n_gate) > 0 strictly; shared split, actions and known propensities.
models_and_gate.preprocessing: Only age and previous_spending predictors, as in the existing simulation; no synthetic true effects as input.

future_trajectories.time_zero: Checking time; immediate deployment panel is independent of gate/training data and has the current response surface.
future_trajectories.zero_delay_duplicates: All profiles are identical at h=0. Retain labelled control rows but do not count them as independent evidence or include their duplicates in the primary average.
future_trajectories.delay_unit: One synthetic period, not an asserted number of real-world hours.
future_trajectories.future_outcome_labels: Not needed for oracle scoring of fixed policies; use declared effects and independent deployment features. Do not train on deployment data.

outcomes.true_pair_gain: Delta_future = mean[(a_candidate(X)-a_incumbent(X))*(tau_future(X)-cost)] on the common independent deployment panel.
outcomes.gate_selection_loss: max(Delta_future,0) - B_gate*Delta_future, where B_gate is 1 for accept and 0 for reject.
outcomes.meaning: Opportunity loss from selecting the worse of two available fixed policies on the finite deployment panel; not regret against the globally optimal individual treatment policy.
outcomes.primary_contrast: For each validation master seed, average refreshed-minus-frozen gate-selection loss equally across its two primary current conditions. Then average those 100 seed-level values. Negative favors refreshing.
outcomes.primary_rationale: A single preselected gradual-continuation case tests ongoing changes. Opposite drift directions and other delays remain fully reported secondary stress tests, avoiding a symmetric pooled target that can algebraically hide direction-specific failures.
secondary: All 45 condition/profile/delay cells per seed for both gates
Gate estimate versus future true pair gain, including signed, absolute and squared errors
Accepted harmful, rejected helpful and tied decisions using future pair gain and tolerance 1e-10
Comparisons with always retain incumbent and always accept candidate; offline best-of-two reference has selection loss zero

timing_decomposition.identity: Sum of the three terms equals estimated_gate_gain - true_future_pair_gain_on_deployment_X.
timing_decomposition.boundary: An accounting identity using known synthetic effects, not a new estimator. Holding feature distributions fixed means the last term is finite-panel variation rather than designed covariate drift.

primary_bootstrap.method: Paired master-seed percentile bootstrap of the 100 seed-level primary differences. Never resample factor cells or customers as independent stream replications.

analysis.primary_monte_carlo_SE: Sample SD of 100 primary seed differences divided by sqrt(100).
analysis.secondary_intervals: Descriptive and unadjusted for multiplicity; no secondary cell promoted to a new primary result.
analysis.report_all_cases: Include ties, adverse profiles and all simple baselines even if the primary contrast is favorable.
analysis.no_equivalence_or_safety_claim: Exact zero differences and zero bootstrap intervals do not establish population equivalence or safety.
analysis.initial_randomness: Inference spans the newly generated initial-data/fitting realizations coupled to the 100 master seeds, within this generator; it is not unrestricted model-population generalization.

execution.pilot_purpose: Engineering, invariants and measured runtime only. Keep allocation/settings fixed; no outcome-driven redesign or pooling with validation.
execution.profile_after_pilot_before_validation: Use measured runtime to assess feasibility. A resource-driven change requires a new version before validation outcomes are generated.
required_checks: Identical candidate/incumbent actions across future response profiles on common X
Identical gate estimates and acceptance across future profiles/delays
Nonnegative selection loss within numerical tolerance
Zero selection loss for offline best-of-two reference
Fixed h=0 response identity across profiles
Exact primary cell count and paired seed aggregation
execution.independent_verification_scope: Saved-output audit is separate from independently refitting every model; describe actual checks without implying refits.
stop_conditions: Missing factor cells or failed invariants
execution.version_mismatch: Stop before any new simulation and record mismatch; version-driven changes require a disclosed protocol revision before pilot.

paper_integration: Separate new-seed mechanistic follow-up motivated by exposed diagnostics. Keep original synthetic, ZOZO and KuaiRand outcomes unchanged. Do not relabel the April 30 observation as prospective validation or claim a newly invented safe gate.
